page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed for balanced compute and memory tasks that require high-speed local scratch space. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance runs on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor based on the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 2.8 GHz. The processor includes 260 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and vector instruction extensions including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. The system is provisioned with 192 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and includes 1933 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage. It operates without dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate dependable general-purpose performance across both single-threaded and parallel workloads. PassMark testing highlights strong CPU encryption capabilities at 43,321.1 and top-quartile database operation throughput at 21,703.24, alongside a strong memory subsystem score of 2,757.12. Multicore execution in stress-ng registers at 46,626.68, while Geekbench image processing achieves 14,001.0 points. While small-model AI inference exhibits strong text generation at 275.95 tokens per second on lightweight 135M parameter models, large-scale LLM processing yields only 2.74 tokens per second on 70B parameter models due to the absence of dedicated matrix accelerators or discrete GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency and architectural standpoint, the D48ds_v5 maximizes value in scenarios requiring high thread concurrency combined with high-speed temporary storage. Bundling 1933 GB of fast local SSD storage reduces the necessity of purchasing separate high-throughput premium managed disks for tempdb storage, caching tiers, or transient compilation artifacts. The 1:4 memory allocation makes it well proportioned for enterprise relational database servers, Redis caching clusters, CI/CD build environments, and data transformation pipelines that need solid I/O and dependable multicore throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose instance featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs and 192 GB of RAM on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture across 24 physical cores with hyperthreading, the instance incorporates 260 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX-512 extensions. The server bundles 1933 GB of high-speed local SSD storage, eliminating the immediate need for auxiliary caching volumes. Benchmark testing shows strong performance in cryptographic processing, database transactions, and memory operations, alongside reliable mid-tier compute throughput across multicore stress workloads. Lacking discrete GPUs, large-scale deep learning generation remains limited. Consequently, the instance is best suited for enterprise relational databases, large-scale software compilation, in-memory caching systems, and heavy ETL batch processing tasks.
